title: Fortress Barrier (General, level 150)
body:
Syntax: perform fortress barrier

The master-level evolution of Barrier, available to every class at level 150 after practicing once. Raise a dense chakra fortress around yourself for up to 300 seconds before duration scaling, preventing 45% of incoming damage. The protection is tied to your current ROOM: leaving it instantly breaks the shield.

Costs 120 Chakra before level scaling; cooldown 25 seconds. Automatically replaces an older/lesser room-bound Barrier. Damage-reduction percentages never stack with Sanctuary or Elemental Shield. Sanctuary remains the strongest at 50%, but follows its owner between rooms. See HELP SANCTUARY.
